title: Different than pic
text: Different than pic. Sorry, I returned this screen. The picture on Amazon looked pretty and delicate. In person it was not what I expected. I hate to leave a bad review because for some it would be wonderful, just not for me.

product_metadata.title: Oriental Furniture 3 ft. Tall Double Sided Birds on Plum Tree Canvas Room Divider
features: Stunning Art Prints: Bring the beauty of classical Chinese art indoors with a high resolution print. Printed with fade-resistant, high color saturation ink, showcase vibrant images that serve as powerful visual focal points for your room

Wood and Canvas Construction: Our room divider features a durable poly-cotton blend canvas ideal for the high resolution print. The durable kiln dried Spruce wood ensures long-lasting performance while being light enough to move and store easily.

Convenient and Functional: This short partition is pre-assembled, making it a breeze to set up whether you need privacy, a quick clutter solution, or a way to block window glare. Lightweight folding design is easy to fold up and store away.

Flexible Double-Hinged Panels: Premium two-way reversible hinges allow the panels to bend in either direction so you can create the perfect configuration to suit your needs. It's a versatile and user-friendly solution for customizing your space.

Versatile Home Decor Accent: Use it on a desk or windowsill, hide clutter, or create an attractive backdrop for plants or sculptures. Short height is ideal for defining or accenting a space without blocking line of sight.
description: This room divider depicts a pair of birds nestling on a tree branch as a third swoops overhead. A celebration of life, this idyllic summer scene has been printed in high resolution on four art-quality canvas panels. The golden hues will complement the décor of any room, and make a lovely accent piece for the home or office. This folding screen is the perfect way to bring the graceful air of Chinese art to your interior décor.
